sentences.text: [deadpan, dry humor] Your phone's at six percent, and Rome just threw you into the arena.
A gladiator lifts his sword, so you think it's a fight to the death.
If you rented a gladiator and he died, you paid his owner fifty times the fee.
So most fights ended with nobody dead, and a referee with a stick could stop it.
So why is the crowd screaming his name?
He's a celebrity, and legend says fans bought his sweat as face cream.
You grab a selfie with him, and the crowd goes wild.
Then the referee points at the other gate.
[lowering their voice] Rome's untrained prisoners were cheap, so nobody cared if they died.
[deadpan, dry humor] And you came free.
[after a long pause] Comment LION for part four.
